# T-4: Implement question coverage review

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Implement review-draft-questions as the pre-answer stage that checks whether pending questions cover user judgment needed for goal achievability.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Stage 1 prompt emits per-category applicability and coverage fields.
- Stage 1 report PASS requires all applicable user-judgment categories to be covered by pending/approved questions or answered QA entries.
- Stage 1 PASS is distinct from step completion; pending QA still requires approve/drop and approved QA still requires asking the user.
- Stage 1 step completion requires the operator to ask approved questions and clear pending/approved QA for that stage.
- Report targets existing entries by qa.id and rejects bare Q<N> for existing entries.
- Stage 1 report contains the machine-readable JSON schema with categories[] and actions[], including approve for pending qa.id entries.
- Stage 1 drop actions require droppedReason for later dropped lifecycle remediation.
- Stage 1 report action validation enforces the mutation matrix and cannot target answered/dropped entries.
- Stage 1 ignores follow-up-coverage entries created by Stage 2.
- Stage 1 update changes category/question only and keeps reason as report-only metadata.
- Stage 1 review command writes only draft-review-questions.md and emits questions=<n>; operator remediation owns draft.json updates and user interaction.
- Stage 1 report actions are proposals only; parser/review command does not mutate draft.json.
- Stage 1 PASS with pending/approved QA keeps next-action on review-draft-questions with remediation-required metadata.
- Stage 1 PASS counters and remediationRequired metadata use the defined parser contract.
- Stage 1 uses agent command id flow.draft.review.questions.propose.
- Stage 1 next-action uses a stage-specific review schema rather than the generic verdict/comments schema.
- PromptBuilder does not append generic review fallback text that conflicts with Stage 1 strict JSON actions.

## Implementation Notes
Add or split prompt/report formatting in src/flow/commands/review.js and the plan prompt for review-draft-questions. Stage 1 may add/update/drop pending questions only during operator remediation; run-review itself must not mutate draft.json. Update review next-action schema coverage for Stage 1 report shape and define the new agent command id in config.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for report parsing/validation and dedupe normalization; agent test fixture where missing acceptance policy yields a pending question.
